bullets.id: Fed menahan suku bunga di 3,75–4,00% dengan voting 10-2; Lisa Cook dan Beth Hammack memilih kenaikan 25 bp. Kitco mencatat spot emas sempat turun 0,60% ke $4.035,48 setelah keputusan, lalu stabil sekitar $4.056,80 di akhir sesi AS. Kamis pagi, Trading Economics menunjukkan emas sekitar $4.048 (turun sekitar 0,5%), turun 2,65% dalam sebulan dan sekitar 27,8% di bawah rekor $5.608,35.
bullets.en: The Fed held rates at 3.75–4.00% in a 10-2 vote; Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack voted for a 25 bp hike. Kitco had spot gold dipping 0.60% to $4,035.48 after the decision, then steadying near $4,056.80 late in the US session. On Thursday morning, Trading Economics shows gold near $4,048 (down about 0.5%), down 2.65% on the month and about 27.8% below its $5,608.35 record.

bullets.id: Ketua Fed Kevin Warsh tidak mau berkomitmen soal Desember: ia menolak forward guidance di luar krisis, tetapi menegaskan kesiapan bertindak. Futures memberi peluang sekitar 83% kenaikan 25 bp pada rapat 8–9 Desember. Yield Treasury 10 tahun dekat 5,0%, 2 tahun di atas 4,76%, indeks dolar sekitar 102,13, Brent sekitar $115 dan WTI sekitar $102.
bullets.en: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh would not commit on December: he rejected forward guidance outside a crisis but stressed the Fed’s readiness to act. Futures give about 83% odds of a 25 bp hike at the December 8–9 meeting. The 10-year Treasury yield is near 5.0%, the 2-year above 4.76%, the dollar index about 102.13, Brent about $115 and WTI about $102.

bullets.id: Agenda berikutnya: PDB kuartal III, PCE September dan klaim pengangguran AS Kamis 19.30 WIB. Kitco mencatat resistance $4.059, $4.079–4.103 dan rata-rata 20 hari dekat $4.124, serta support $4.039, $4.015, $3.975 dan $3.942–3.936; tembus di bawah $4.015 menjadi pemicu bagi penjual. Sucden Financial melihat risiko turun ke sekitar $3.900 sebelum rapat Desember.
bullets.en: Next up: US Q3 GDP, September PCE and jobless claims on Thursday at 19:30 WIB. Kitco puts resistance at $4,059, $4,079–4,103 and the 20-day average near $4,124, with support at $4,039, $4,015, $3,975 and $3,942–3,936; a break below $4,015 is the sellers’ trigger. Sucden Financial sees a risk of a drop to about $3,900 before the December meeting.

bullets.id: Harga Antam 1 gram turun Rp11.000 ke Rp2.559.000 setelah dua hari naik; buyback turun Rp11.000 ke Rp2.354.000 (spread Rp205.000, sekitar 8,0%). Galeri24 justru naik ke Rp2.499.000 (buyback Rp2.355.000, spread sekitar 5,8%) dan UBS ke Rp2.524.000 (buyback Rp2.329.000, spread sekitar 7,7%). Secara struktural, Sucden mencatat PBoC membeli 23 ton pada September dan ETF emas mencetak rekor 101,55 juta ons.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price fell Rp11,000 to Rp2,559,000 after two days of gains; buyback fell Rp11,000 to Rp2,354,000 (a Rp205,000 spread, about 8.0%). Galeri24 instead rose to Rp2,499,000 (buyback Rp2,355,000, spread about 5.8%) and UBS to Rp2,524,000 (buyback Rp2,329,000, spread about 7.7%). Structurally, Sucden notes the PBoC bought 23 tonnes in September and gold ETFs hit a record 101.55 million oz.
